Mohieth Mayura S Y is an independent full-stack product engineer and visual designer based in Bengaluru. With 4+ years of hands-on experience, Mayura operates across the entire product spectrum — from user research, wireframing, and Swiss-style brutalist visual systems to frontend engineering, distributed backends, real-time WebRTC audio pipelines, and open-source fine-tuned conversational AI models. His design motto is: "I design it, I build it, I ship it."

2. COMPREHENSIVE PROJECT PORTFOLIO
================================================================================

Project 01: YULYA — Discord AI Companion
- Category: AI / Discord Bot / Real-time Voice / Full Stack
- Status: Live Production (https://discord.yulya.me)
- Code Repository: https://github.com/moheith/Yulya
- Technology Stack: Python, Google Gemini Live API, WebRTC, MongoDB, Discord API
- Architecture & Features:
  * Full duplex, ultra-low latency voice chat using WebRTC audio channels.
  * Multi-persona conversational capability with persistent long-term memory.
  * Multimodal comprehension: real-time analysis of images, documents, and videos inside Discord channels.
  * In-server simulated economy featuring dynamic crypto markets, player inventory, and cooperative heists.

Project 02: Yulya Studio
- Category: Browser Game Engine / Web Application / Developer Tools
- Status: Live Production (https://studio.yulya.me)
- Code Repository: https://github.com/moheith/Studio
- Technology Stack: React, TypeScript, Vite, FastAPI, MongoDB, Gemini AI
- Architecture & Features:
  * Browser-native game development studio allowing users to code, preview, and play static 2D/3D games directly in the browser.
  * Integrated AI copilot embedded in a sandboxed runtime environment for on-the-fly code generation and debugging.
  * Public community gallery with instant one-click game remixing and state fork trees.

Project 03: LEARNEXA 2.0
- Category: Educational Platform / Recommendation Engine / Full Stack
- Status: Shipped (https://github.com/moheith/LEARNEXA-2.0)
- Technology Stack: Flask (Python), Next.js, TypeScript, SQLite / MySQL
- Architecture & Features:
  * Peer-to-peer student skill exchange ecosystem.
  * TF-IDF mathematical vector recommendation engine calculating mutual match percentages between teaching offers and learning requests.
  * Automated session scheduling calendar, credit reward points ledger, and peer review verification.

Project 04: Yulya Conversational Models Family
